programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 泰國清邁有一種世代以手相傳200多年的手工藝品-泰國紙傘 製作紙傘工序繁複, 取於自然的原材料, 靠著工匠的精湛手藝, 華麗變身成為色彩絢麗的泰國紙傘, 更是象徵清邁的手工藝品

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 沙巴有一集住宅、購物中心、酒店等建設的大型項目，眾人參觀示範單位，巧遇在當地發展飲食生意的香港人，順道向她瞭解投資商機。品嚐地道炒粉麵美食期間，馬貫東提到退休後希望移居海邊，享受寧靜生活。三位美女聞言即租下一輛特色露營車，帶他到沙灘「Hea嚇傾嚇偈」。海風輕輕吹起，貫東打開心扉，還對着鏡頭向家人吐心聲。美女們又重提為貫東炮製的驚喜生日會，貫東如何被整？行程尾聲，三位閨密乘船出海，互訴旅途深刻點滴。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，淑雅、衍峯請來「美人魚」何泳芍一同出海，探索西貢地質公園的世界級奇巖怪石。遊遍橋咀洲、吊鐘洲、果洲羣島，觀賞獨特風化巖洞。衍峯、泳芍急不及待潛水，細看海底生態！祖儀隨衍峯、淑雅遠離煩囂，往南丫島行山，順道體驗漁村文化。眾人由榕樹灣走到索罟灣，再登上漁排參觀漁民文化村，瞭解漁民的生活樂趣，然後回岸品嚐正宗海鮮大餐。穎彤夥拍嘉賓菊梓喬，與衍峯上演室內War Game大決鬥，最終鹿死誰手？

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 外國喜劇演員佔基利以誇張的面部表情、豐富的肢體語言，帶給觀眾無限歡樂。谷主汛文整理了佔基利的經典搞笑表情包，還與拍檔凱婷、泳嘉模仿其中三個，相似度如何？這位「喜劇之王」曾自揭患有抑鬱症，汛文提到這某程度反映「悲傷小丑悖論」，並指不少經典笑匠背後同樣藏有不為人知的悲傷。汛文亦概述佔基利的成長故事，其幽默的起點，或許源於兒時希望逗抑鬱症母親開心。三位谷主還分享各自最欣賞的佔基利電影，竟都不是喜劇作品？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐示範鹹豆漿。她這次用了新穎的組合去烹調，如櫻花蝦、飯素和紫菜，還有其他常見的配料，如榨菜、米醋和油條。她提到烹煮豆漿時不需要煮至沸騰，把所有材料放進碗裡後，把剛沸騰的豆漿倒進去便可以享用。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 永城這集引領小朋友翻開「美醜」課題，先要大家說出最喜歡與眼中最美的藝人，永城是某孩子的選擇？長得美麗可會有好處？眾人各有想法。節目組還讓小朋友嘗試從兩個同品種的水果中選擇較好味一個，他們從中領略到外觀美麗的水果不一定較滋味。三位孩子互相拍照，永城看過作品，決定親自指導影靚相的技巧。永城要求兩位女生於園藝店內，各自選出認為最美與最醜的植物，她們有甚麼準則？大家又嘗試競猜植物的價錢，又可會跟外表掛鉤？

programme.title: 地球大神祕粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神祕，我們會繼續從世界各地神祕事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴在鐵路同好的介紹下認識Delta，對方亦有在元宇宙建設鐵路，加上年紀相同，兩人一見如故。太晴約了一眾朋友去逛夏日祭，伊奈也獲準外出參與，玩得興高采烈之際，卻突然傳來敵人出現的警報。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 繼續有兒童體適能教練主理「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，拉伸手臂後就完成熱身。首先是爆發力訓練，一直向前走，沿路要蹲下或以弓箭步形式來觸碰地上的飛碟，加入聽指令運送豆袋、分隊鬥快元素，更能引導大家將潛能釋放。休息過後，就拿起橡筋帶，完成開胸及拉向後背的動作。跪在瑜伽墊，再做一輪掌上壓；轉二人一組，用橡筋帶製造「波浪」。最後教練還任由大家發揮創意，試試不用腳的情況下前後移動，集中鍛練上肢部位。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在姐姐的同學面前，把姐姐的帽子沾上了鳥糞的事說了出來，令姐姐很不滿。小丸子因為怕辣，而被爸爸與姐姐嘲笑。之後小丸子見到幾位同學都不怕喫紅薑，令小丸子萌生了改變自己的念頭。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 巿面上有不少證書課程，聲稱獲美國、英國、南韓等國際權威資格認證，吸引不同業界報讀，部分課程收費數萬至十萬元。這些機構是如何認證課程呢？他們本身又有無合適資格去做專業認證？香港不少培訓機構提供這些證書課程，學員取得資格後可以擔任導師收生及提供服務，對消費者造成甚麼影響呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某健身中心職員近期涉不良銷售被海關拘捕，舉報人細述遭對方一男一女誘騙、大漢威嚇，被迫繳款做會員的經過。網上訂購蛋糕後，店方稱不能交付，並被要求點擊連結作退款，事主擔心有伏；記者假裝顧客探查。女子在機艙被空少倒咖啡時淥到腳部，她向航空公司客服詢問後續處理，回覆竟稱沒相關記錄？事主接居住大廈管理員通知，其單位出現漏水狀況。事主下班回家發現淹水蔓延全屋、電器短路，更驚悉樓上漏水漏足八小時！究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻：退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 平日愛下廚減壓的黃博為藍男夫婦準備泰、川美食，同時透露以環遊世界唱歌為退休願景。醫生鐘健禮則希望可享受無拘無束的退休旅行，並計劃循序漸進退休，還分享保持健康體魄的要訣。這集帶觀眾參觀泰國華欣國際級高球場附近的豪宅，環境優美，屋內更設透明電梯；主持亦體驗當野生動物義工，退休後仍何貢獻社會。主持們在深圳學駕帆船出海，感受「Chill」舒適樂趣；又到訪珠海的康養酒店，享受不同養生療程，展現多元退休生活。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！《聲夢傳奇》唱將Windy詹天文接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 張德蘭被問到一些回望過去的問題，要靠答案喚回記憶？德蘭姐姐將為出道60週年舉行演淐會，相信屆時亦會唱<相識也是緣份和<情義兩心堅，她亦帶來新歌<惜緣。馬天佑為新作<一世人做一次傻仔邀得逾八十多位歌手拍片合唱，當中更有人專程回港？葉巧琳推出<不是那種勵志歌，那麼這種勵志歌又是如何？節目倒數「勁歌金榜」排名，有一首新歌名為<萬刀甲，主唱者方力申受訪細談歌曲概念，同時預告個唱重點。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 汕頭除了滷水鵝聞名，經滷製的鵝肝口感肥美細膩；遠在法國，當地廚師亦是烹調鵝肝的大行家。意大利摩德納有一種名為豬蹄鑲肉的美食，將豬蹄拆骨釀入肉餡，再以低溫烘烤而成。鮟鱇魚這種深海魚，魚肝甘香，蒸煮後成為和風料理中的高級菜餚。在廣州，街頭飄送着牛雜、滷豬腳等的香氣，成為市井小食代表。浙江某個以手工釀造黃酒聞名的小鎮，在地民眾會利用釀酒後剩下的糟為豬蹄發酵增香；上海的糟豬蹄則以糟滷浸泡製作，風味各異。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 場地單車世界盃香港站結束，這集搜羅比賽精華，一探海外選手來港參賽感受，以及裁判、支援團隊情況；三位年青港將也分享得着。NBL總決賽，香港金牛以總場數3比0擊敗對手，成就三連霸。拜仁慕尼黑與阿士東維拉將在啟德上演表演賽，名宿艾芬保、麥恩拿利來港宣傳。十八鄉鄉事委員會公益社中學三位中、長跑小將，在元朗區學界賽錄佳績，訓練上付出多少？冰球方面，帶來港隊出戰男子IIIB級別世錦賽戰報、大型五人賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
寒戰粵PG
programme.desc: 警隊衝鋒車午夜被劫持，車內五位警員包括行動副處長李文彬獨子。下任處長兩大熱門人選：鷹派人物李文彬與年輕的劉傑輝都開始大施拳腳。文彬立即指揮營救，但賊人對警隊內部一切瞭如指掌，眾同袍懷疑他的決策，推舉傑輝接手整個行動。交收贖金過程中，傑輝設法令贖金留下線索，以便追查賊人位置。可是道高一尺，魔高一丈，傑輝非但找不著賊人蹤跡，還失卻巨額贖金，香港警隊陷入前所未有的危急與威脅……

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某健身中心職員近期涉不良銷售被海關拘捕，舉報人細述遭對方一男一女誘騙、大漢威嚇，被迫繳款做會員的經過。網上訂購蛋糕後，店方稱不能交付，並被要求點擊連結作退款，事主擔心有伏；記者假裝顧客探查。女子在機艙被空少倒咖啡時淥到腳部，她向航空公司客服詢問後續處理，回覆竟稱沒相關記錄？事主接居住大廈管理員通知，其單位出現漏水狀況。事主下班回家發現淹水蔓延全屋、電器短路，更驚悉樓上漏水漏足八小時！究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，淑雅、衍峯請來「美人魚」何泳芍一同出海，探索西貢地質公園的世界級奇巖怪石。遊遍橋咀洲、吊鐘洲、果洲羣島，觀賞獨特風化巖洞。衍峯、泳芍急不及待潛水，細看海底生態！祖儀隨衍峯、淑雅遠離煩囂，往南丫島行山，順道體驗漁村文化。眾人由榕樹灣走到索罟灣，再登上漁排參觀漁民文化村，瞭解漁民的生活樂趣，然後回岸品嚐正宗海鮮大餐。穎彤夥拍嘉賓菊梓喬，與衍峯上演室內War Game大決鬥，最終鹿死誰手？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 沙巴有一集住宅、購物中心、酒店等建設的大型項目，眾人參觀示範單位，巧遇在當地發展飲食生意的香港人，順道向她瞭解投資商機。品嚐地道炒粉麵美食期間，馬貫東提到退休後希望移居海邊，享受寧靜生活。三位美女聞言即租下一輛特色露營車，帶他到沙灘「Hea嚇傾嚇偈」。海風輕輕吹起，貫東打開心扉，還對着鏡頭向家人吐心聲。美女們又重提為貫東炮製的驚喜生日會，貫東如何被整？行程尾聲，三位閨密乘船出海，互訴旅途深刻點滴。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 「美醜」定義各有不同，有人注重外表，為了展現最美一面，會將照片修飾到滿意後才於社交媒體發放；有人則認為相由心生，內涵更重要。節目組請來四位藝人作自我介紹，並進行二選一問答與才藝表演，小朋友對各人的審美觀感可有變化？劉展霆、李爾晨均選擇以事業為先，為何被扣印象分？黃洛妍的小提琴造詣，打動小朋友心坎；獲讚顏值高的陳星妤，表演魔術卻似有失分……經過這次體驗，孩子們都認同才華內涵可令人發光發亮，變得更美！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 泰國清邁有一種世代以手相傳200多年的手工藝品-泰國紙傘 製作紙傘工序繁複, 取於自然的原材料, 靠著工匠的精湛手藝, 華麗變身成為色彩絢麗的泰國紙傘, 更是象徵清邁的手工藝品

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 手造皮鞋製作步驟繁複，黃耀英、黃建東請纓協助師傅造鞋，二人可會是「生蟲柺杖」？貨船上的「律囉」用作吊起貨物，亦撐起了四代木製品店的生計。律囉零件講求處處精準，製造過程更是「有規有矩」！歇後語「東莞臘腸－ 短肚闊封」，道出了廣東人機智靈巧的特質，這款特色臘腸還促成一段美滿良緣！粵劇團當然希望演出大收旺場，「爆棚」一詞原來叫人又喜又悲？另外，中文講師廖舜禧變身「生物教授」，揭開「好眉好貌生沙蝨」之謎。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 採用印度上乘檀香木製成的優質檀香扇，造工精緻且散發陣陣幽香。幸美被指「檀香木冚茅廁」，究竟怎麼一回事？郭師傅藉着拿手的雕刻工藝，為木製家品添上藝術美感；他在木板上刻字，當然不像主持般「木偶談戀愛－ 呆頭呆腦」！掌故專家鄭寶鴻提到昔日戲院觀眾喜歡「咬蔗」，還大談「揀蔗」心得，意欲何為？經過影視作品的傳講，金葉菊、梁天來成了悲慘人生的代名詞；大學講師廖舜禧亦會講解「豬頭丙」、「諸事喱」等趣怪人名起源。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 世上最臭的食物有多恐怖？農夫以行動告知！臺灣有何獨特形式喫臭豆腐？同時設自助洗衣區及咖啡店的三藩市小店，為何晚上才吸引顧客？馬國明、陳煒絞盡腦汁回答一系列問題，還一同欣賞曼谷大師的「Do姐肖像果雕」。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 安德尊的出現，令大廳出現濃濃火藥味！Do姐、薛家燕兩位阿姐如何應對？陸永還嚷着想與大王割席，到底發生了甚麼事？今集問題與東京「站起」的天婦羅、曼谷窩夫高塔、臺北蛋糕大師有關，過程發現大王的一連串缺點！

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 星夢頻道樂園將要舉辦尋找星夢彩蛋大作戰的活動，為了讓閃耀組贏出，閃亮CHU拼命地找星夢彩蛋，卻沒有任何收穫。另一方面，Meltic StAr與玫露熊則順利的找到星夢彩蛋，讓兩邊的差距越來越大……

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄在七夕節許願祈求變得聰明，多啦A夢用法寶教他織女星和牛郎星的位置，意外發現顛倒星球。大雄用塑膠布自製小型降落傘，多啦A夢用縮小電筒把大雄縮小，讓他可以一嘗跳降落傘的滋味。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 剛開始獨居生活的大學一年級生真子，是個為人內向，舉止靦腆的女生。她的生活樂趣來自喫東西與下廚。某一天，小學時的竹馬之交詩音突然找上真子，邀請真子加入她與朋友成立的新學會，飲食文化研究會。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 上海設有不少千奇百趣的博物館，陳約臨到訪「失戀」博物館，卻勾起一段段美好而痛苦的回憶；再踩入玩味十足的「即食麵世界」，竟玩到「索曬氣」？緊接轉往琉璃博物館，培養藝術氣息。人氣書局以全透明玻璃設計，「偽文青」約臨慕名前來打卡兼買書，好夢幻！特色中菜餐廳主打多種Fusion美食，「北京烤鴨」配爆炸糖同喫，引發味蕾新衝擊！約臨及後換上華服走進懷舊舞廳，用餐之餘，也到舞池擺動身體，感受浪漫的上海灘情懷。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 香料雖只是菜餚中的配角，卻可提升味道層次，不可或缺。主持們這次在農場採摘迷迭香、小茴香等香草，還找到清甜的粟米，返回廚房製成惹味非一般的「椒鹽粟米」。黃薑有改善關節炎等功效，「黃薑茴香煮野雞」既滋味又有益。上碟前阿媽特意加入牛油，有何妙用？另一道「香草雜菜燉豬柳」，則是佐飯推介。阿媽又用紹酒烹調西式菜「香草煮青口」，中西合壁更添美味。二人期間突然上演「正字廚房」，6號更疑有發音困難，究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雪膠含有豐富植物膠質，養顏功效媲美燕窩。肥媽還為「粟米蟹肉雪膠羮」加入矜貴蟹黃，鮮味隨之激增！白玉木耳的爽脆口感令人想起海蜇，因而啟發出「涼拌白玉木耳」配搭靈感。肥媽悉心主理這道消暑美食，一個透明膠袋何以成為讓食材入味的祕物武器？假不但可亂真，也未必比真貨遜色。阿媽採用高蛋白質、具降脂功效的鮮猴頭菇製作「素咕嚕肉」，倍添健康而且美味依然。「酥皮焗荷蘭小牛柳」則以香脆酥皮鎖緊鮮嫩肉汁，盡顯烹飪智慧。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 五位藝員的任務，是建造一條可行駛客貨車的橋樑。眾人前往建造學院接受訓練，允瑜的衣著竟成焦點？建橋涉及紮鐵、釘板、落石屎等工序，如掌握相關機器的用法，過程可望事半功倍，衍峯卻錯手「搞亂檔」！鈺洧屈鐵造「洛仔」時的表情，竟似在坐過山車，但總算獲導師給予七十分評價。釘板看似只是「揼釘」，若要做到合格，必需虛心學好當中技巧，德賢實戰過才知其困難。徐榮亦視這趟工地體驗為挑戰，希望學以致用，有助解決家居問題。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 經過基本工序訓練，五位藝員於導師們指引下，在搭好的橋樑底座釘板，鈺洧、允瑜感謝導師耐心地指導揼釘，並由衷敬佩建造工人。接着是紮鐵，喜歡做重複工作的鈺洧獲讚，笑言想轉行？落石屎、拆板之後，土木工程系區教授隨即檢查橋身混凝土的強度，五人的建橋表現又值幾多分？徐榮與鈺洧、允瑜登上客貨車，為橋樑進行負重測試，車內美女怕得要死，車外的衍峯、德賢同樣緊張萬分……不可能任務結束，眾人回顧箇中歷程，有何深刻感受？

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 餘思霆收拾好行李，請一日假便飛臺北，獲地膽拍檔金剛接機，即搭機場捷運向市中心出發！旅程第一餐品嚐足料雞腿湯，未喫完已心思思要到寧夏夜市，尋覓同獲「車胎人」推介的芋餅、豬肝湯與蚵仔煎。日間於隱世咖啡店享用三層塔茶點，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，啟動門口機關，走進以蜂巢為主題的設計格局並淺酌一番。翌晨，兩人排長龍買早餐，再登上公園邊賞花邊醫肚，偏黑色的滷肉飯有多滋味？下午行程有兩款選擇，歎啡、浸溫泉，悉隨尊便。

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，喫到盡！先有抵食海鮮加肉材一人一鍋，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再來意想不到的鹽酥雞當宵夜；連放鬆做Spa都有點心喫？第三日早上，兩大行程可揀，好動的可以滑水，金剛體驗「沙發滑水」，感受如何？愛靜的可跟思霆往赤峯街商圈做個文青，購物、打卡、來個小清新套餐。終極血拼階段，到永康街一帶尋找合適手信，臺灣特色小食、茶葉、精緻生活小物，任君選擇。上機前再享用炭火烹製的薑母鴨，記住金剛建議最後才喫鴨肉！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 何艷娟(Katherine)，畢業於香港大學法律系，體現港姐「美貌與智慧並重」的格言。Katherine才貌雙全，製作一般甜品當然難不倒她，古嘉俊於是給她進階挑戰，試做花巧、層次豐富的「法式紅莓榛子泡芺」，測試她的廚藝。紅莓吉士以牛奶、蛋黃、淡忌廉炮製，幼滑口感為食家帶來窩心感受，新鮮紅莓散發的天然果酸還添上清新口味。做律師要心思細密，繁複步驟未能難倒Katherine，體力反而成為她的最大考驗。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴一行人在落合帶領下前往九州接受訓練，認識到當地的駕駛員海風九十九。進行模擬戰鬥時，九十九欲進行支援合體，卻因指令員經驗不足而失敗。室長中谷希望落合幫忙指導兩名新進指令員。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 女生在「My Little Show」帶來節奏感十足的敲擊樂演出，並提到可用不同棍子製造各種特色的聲音。兩男兩女團隊則表演節拍舞蹈，動作合拍，展現活力。歡聚唱歌時間，這次以「團結的力量」為主題，彤彤姐姐、Tiffany姐姐和結他導師合唱<一枝竹仔、<最佳拍檔。主持們還分享拍攝《Hands Up》的深刻點滴，彤彤姐姐被拍檔笑稱是「小傻瓜」！此外，導師亦即場「拆解」結他，讓觀眾認識其內部結構。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 宏志和阿山去河邊釣魚，卻突然鬧反，小丸子和小玉看在眼裡，決定要永遠做好朋友，友誼永固。花輪邀請大家到家裡擲飛鏢，小丸子志在喫到美味甜點，卻因為陶醉於美味達到心無雜念，成功命中紅心。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 三月一手住宅買賣有回落跡象，反而二手交投卻顯著增加，究竟本地樓市有多大的復蘇動力？越來越多零售店會在店內同時兼賣咖啡，這個安排對帶動整體業務有幾大影響？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 在三、四十年代，日本軍國主義興起，逐步擴大對華侵略，亦看中中國東北地區肥沃的黑色土壤，計劃20年間向中國東北遷移一百萬戶，稱為「日本開拓團」，打算透過不斷輸送農業貧民來到東北，試圖變成日本永久的殖民地，不過後來日本戰敗，軍政府自顧不暇，開拓團團民亦要展開逃亡，當中有四千多名日本兒童，因此被遺留在中國，成為了日本遺孤。今集將會瞭解兩名日本遺孤，郜鳳琴及大原朋二，被中國養父母撫養成人的故事。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 本輪「快慢二重奏」分為兩集，二十強參賽者依據上輪成績輪流揀選歌曲，組成二人團隊，以合唱形式開展隊制對壘，並分別舉行慢歌上半場、快歌下半場的比拼。每場對壘後，評審們會在勝出隊伍中挑選一位選手，頒發晉級襟章。當快慢歌比拼全部結束後，未能獲得襟章的選手中，將有兩人被淘汰，而這集率先上演慢歌比拼。

programme.title: 一週星星粵
programme.desc: 羅志祥的巡唱即將舉行香港站，有何準備？他幽默回答是要喝紅豆冰！「小豬」這暱稱其實源自年少時很胖，也因此備受霸凌，他還自揭腿上「傷疤」。母親近年確診亞茲海默症，小豬於是常貼身照顧她，一次陪診，卻被醫生告知自己患有微笑憂鬱症？小豬指出，每個人都要找到抒發情緒的出口。打高爾夫球又讓他學會了甚麼？「你問我答」，關嘉敏鬥膽拍片在高手面前講冷笑話，要求評分；葉泓聲感謝小豬曾轉發其演出片段，更親自到場答謝偶像！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚陳佑良帶波波到訪一間主打生炸雞髀的餐廳，試喫流心芝士吉列豬扒及招牌生炸髀，陳師傅更示範生炸髀的特別喫法。荃灣地膽Ryan推介區內泰國餐廳，必喫咖喱軟殼蟹配烤餅、燒豬頸肉飯及雞肉串燒，並分享私藏的地膽喫法。暉哥與鼎爺造訪星級中菜館，細味老菜脯脆皮燒鵝及工序繁複的遼參佳餚，滿是驚喜滋味！中韓混血兒李明憲則帶葉靖儀品嚐韓式炸雞，包括楓糖蒜香及祕製醬風味，同樣皮脆肉嫩，還有玫瑰忌廉炒年糕，酸辣惹味。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
疊影狙擊#19粵PG
programme.desc: 晨和傑合作，欲以殺雄來引出Cat。另一方面，Mag亦奉命殺雄，雄為保命，命Cat綁架飛以威脅晨當自己保鏢及殺Mag，晨假意順從，暗中拜託傑和諾找飛。晨被擒，諾為救晨向Mag開出優厚條件。飛獲救，惟身受重創…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 五位藝員的任務，是建造一條可行駛客貨車的橋樑。眾人前往建造學院接受訓練，允瑜的衣著竟成焦點？建橋涉及紮鐵、釘板、落石屎等工序，如掌握相關機器的用法，過程可望事半功倍，衍峯卻錯手「搞亂檔」！鈺洧屈鐵造「洛仔」時的表情，竟似在坐過山車，但總算獲導師給予七十分評價。釘板看似只是「揼釘」，若要做到合格，必需虛心學好當中技巧，德賢實戰過才知其困難。徐榮亦視這趟工地體驗為挑戰，希望學以致用，有助解決家居問題。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 經過基本工序訓練，五位藝員於導師們指引下，在搭好的橋樑底座釘板，鈺洧、允瑜感謝導師耐心地指導揼釘，並由衷敬佩建造工人。接着是紮鐵，喜歡做重複工作的鈺洧獲讚，笑言想轉行？落石屎、拆板之後，土木工程系區教授隨即檢查橋身混凝土的強度，五人的建橋表現又值幾多分？徐榮與鈺洧、允瑜登上客貨車，為橋樑進行負重測試，車內美女怕得要死，車外的衍峯、德賢同樣緊張萬分……不可能任務結束，眾人回顧箇中歷程，有何深刻感受？

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 跟過往旅途不盡相同，何沛珈、李芷晴這次放工後纔到機場，抵達泰國曼谷已入夜，沛珈未忘為好姊妹準備猛男生日派對，並附大量海鮮！狂歡過後，已是行程第二天。換上校服，走進大學感受校園氣息，再到學生長龍店食碗「媽媽麵」。花半小時坐車往近郊一間咖啡店，值得嗎？原來是網美勝地，還可劃小艇和打韆鞦，打卡、休閒皆一流！創意市集尋寶，她們看上了哪款時裝？隨後登上由舊飛機改造的餐廳，享用廉價精緻餐飲，暫時放低減肥大事。

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 沛珈、芷晴租著泰服，再乘觀光船往鄭王廟留影，打卡初嘗教訓後，提醒大家要早點到場，究竟怎麼回事？兩女自言第一次享受Spa，單是揀精油已花去不少時間。然後試試「曼谷十大名廚」之一主理的摘星餐廳菜餚，賣相與美味兼備。走入夜市，當然要買手信！節目組為主持各提供一千泰銖鬥買得多，沛珈講價不成都照買，滿腦策略的芷晴執行力又怎樣？此外，行程亦有酒吧、設計週活動推介。旅途最後一晚，她們於泳池中互訴心聲，感觸良多。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 何艷娟(Katherine)，畢業於香港大學法律系，體現港姐「美貌與智慧並重」的格言。Katherine才貌雙全，製作一般甜品當然難不倒她，古嘉俊於是給她進階挑戰，試做花巧、層次豐富的「法式紅莓榛子泡芺」，測試她的廚藝。紅莓吉士以牛奶、蛋黃、淡忌廉炮製，幼滑口感為食家帶來窩心感受，新鮮紅莓散發的天然果酸還添上清新口味。做律師要心思細密，繁複步驟未能難倒Katherine，體力反而成為她的最大考驗。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 上海設有不少千奇百趣的博物館，陳約臨到訪「失戀」博物館，卻勾起一段段美好而痛苦的回憶；再踩入玩味十足的「即食麵世界」，竟玩到「索曬氣」？緊接轉往琉璃博物館，培養藝術氣息。人氣書局以全透明玻璃設計，「偽文青」約臨慕名前來打卡兼買書，好夢幻！特色中菜餐廳主打多種Fusion美食，「北京烤鴨」配爆炸糖同喫，引發味蕾新衝擊！約臨及後換上華服走進懷舊舞廳，用餐之餘，也到舞池擺動身體，感受浪漫的上海灘情懷。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 香料雖只是菜餚中的配角，卻可提升味道層次，不可或缺。主持們這次在農場採摘迷迭香、小茴香等香草，還找到清甜的粟米，返回廚房製成惹味非一般的「椒鹽粟米」。黃薑有改善關節炎等功效，「黃薑茴香煮野雞」既滋味又有益。上碟前阿媽特意加入牛油，有何妙用？另一道「香草雜菜燉豬柳」，則是佐飯推介。阿媽又用紹酒烹調西式菜「香草煮青口」，中西合壁更添美味。二人期間突然上演「正字廚房」，6號更疑有發音困難，究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雪膠含有豐富植物膠質，養顏功效媲美燕窩。肥媽還為「粟米蟹肉雪膠羮」加入矜貴蟹黃，鮮味隨之激增！白玉木耳的爽脆口感令人想起海蜇，因而啟發出「涼拌白玉木耳」配搭靈感。肥媽悉心主理這道消暑美食，一個透明膠袋何以成為讓食材入味的祕物武器？假不但可亂真，也未必比真貨遜色。阿媽採用高蛋白質、具降脂功效的鮮猴頭菇製作「素咕嚕肉」，倍添健康而且美味依然。「酥皮焗荷蘭小牛柳」則以香脆酥皮鎖緊鮮嫩肉汁，盡顯烹飪智慧。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#84粵
programme.desc: 婷在家中大演話劇，目的是要朋準許她到臺灣進行粵劇交流，但朋不肯答應。婷為逹目的竟到藥房靜坐，剛巧遠房親戚的孫子Madison，趁暑假由美來港投靠慶。陰差陽錯下，婷與Madison兩人竟到了離島度宿。

programme.title: 尚食#24粵普
programme.desc: 皇帝駕崩，皇后祕而不宣，要等太子回京；異常的氣氛惹起眾人的懷疑。有人到太子的書齋偷拿點心，被子衿抓到；漢王趙王突然回京，還指定要看醫史，幸太子妃幫忙才化險為夷；太子回程遭暗殺，他最終能否逃脫…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 正宗北京涮羊肉配以自製混醬，符合阿譚的「重口味」要求，「五合一」而成的羊肉胚別具口感，喫得好刁鑽！鼎爺回到廚房示範「老北京炸醬麵」，以大量乾蔥增加炸醬的香味；下冰糖則可中和乾黃醬與甜麵醬的鹹味。「爆」有分多種煮法，鼎爺以「芫爆」方式炮製「爆肚」，有何祕訣？牛百葉要切成幼絲，才適合猛火快炒。做「拔絲水果」不宜選擇水分太多的水果，炸香蕉、紫薯前要沾上不同配料？冰水能令拔絲糖漿凝固成脆糖面，賣相加分！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高膽固醇是「三高」之中最為人忽視，但高膽固醇會引致心血管疾病，所以更加值得留意。《醫度講》這集，藝人鮑聖光前來細談患高膽固醇情況。此外，胡依諾醫生為大家解構高膽固醇問題，而中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟各位分享高膽固醇的食療與按摩穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#16粵
programme.desc: 若嵐帶領眾人捉姦，果然發現九妹與雙春一起；永禎向飛揚說出如果他能拯救雙春及九妹便答應離開佼佼鎮。眾人在祠堂公審雙春與九妹，在祠堂外偷聽的永禎，明白九妹想公開自己的太監身分讓雙春脫罪……飛揚與鎮長及所長提出欲把大事化小，鎮長決定把雙春與九妹逐出佼佼鎮……若嵐打算與永禎上契成為母子，飛揚在眾人前只得贊成。勝天得悉眾人將往廟宇，特意安排金鳳與婉君暢談。眾人喫茶點時，婉君說出當年與飛揚及勝天相遇之往事……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神祕的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 旱地冰壺是一項老少咸宜、「傷健共融」的運動，它與傳統冰壺有何不同？「Kids’ Notes」請來總會主席、港隊教練與成員，為大家介紹這項團體競技運動的賽制和特點。旱地冰壺比賽中，要靠四位隊員先後推出冰壺，力求讓己方隊伍的冰壺最接近紅心，當中也講求戰術策略的運用與互補合作的團隊精神。三位嘉賓當初緣何接觸旱地冰壺？他們還會細談推動運動與參與比賽的難忘經驗。另播放《公雞和寶石》的AI生成動畫上半部。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄一家收拾雜物，發現曾曾祖父大吉留下的宗卷，內容揭示他生前曾遇神祕天災，兩人乘時光機回去一探究竟。多啦A夢用法寶「不費氣力搬運紙」搬運沉重垃圾，大雄卻想到利用其特性自製海報。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2794粵
programme.desc: 凌凌拍攝城安與女演員的表白戲份，女演員質疑表白後何以沒有接吻場面，認為凌凌、城安單身太久，缺乏戀愛經驗。凌凌、城安接受壯的提議，參加戀愛綜藝節目，並順利入選，期待和年輕美女嘉賓擦出火花，怎料卻生變故，二人察覺不妥……出於某些原因，凌凌、城安沒法抽身離去，遂打算以置身事外的態度完成拍攝，冷嘲熱諷其他參加者的表現。有參加者被揭發「出陰招」對付對手，箇中卻另有內情，事情的發展更令凌凌、城安有所反思……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#21粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知遭彈劾，能否待在法官席，關鍵一票落在方官手上。淑樺篤定方官肯定會乘勢趕走惠知，結果卻出乎意料。天雪暈倒入院，惠知與光正趕至，得知天雪涉嫌謀殺景翔！惠知護女心切，毅然辭去法官一職，轉以資深大律師身分，全力為天雪辯護。光正得悉謀殺案請來的外判檢控官，正是淑樺，而審理此案的則是邵文。惠知與淑樺庭上對決，連挑選陪審團成員都已針鋒相對。惠知急欲尋找案中的關鍵證人美寶，偏偏行蹤不明……

programme.title: 大生意人#16粵普
programme.desc: 經晉大奶奶提點，平原決定去找玉兒提親。平原回到安徽發現依梅已離開。平原跟娘提出向玉兒提親的事，娘便拿出聘禮給平原。平原去到常府，黑子處處刁難，四爺卻熱情款待；玉兒一直躲起來不肯見平原，直至他表明心意…

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 主打蒸排骨的食肆凌晨四時半已幾近爆滿，GM帶隊夜探，可會令拍檔失望而遭鬧爆？美儀姐以禾蟲腸粉「回禮」，直擊震撼烹調畫面，朱仔、GM未要放入口，已被生猛蟲蟲驚嚇……有餐廳以原隻爆膏蟹、肥美生蠔煮煲仔飯，加上飯焦不黐煲，獲主持認證。喫煲仔飯都可獵奇，豬眼口味以形補形，GM卻稱似食芝麻湯丸？人氣糖水店以免費續添一次、隨時調整甜度作招徠，鴨母捻、海石花等「老闆娘推介」，贏得港人食甜品最高評價「唔係好甜」！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#14粵
programme.desc: 楊光說服志成平息事件。國富送院醫治，美麗大罵國富鬧出婚外情，憤然離家。國棟裝堅強，實未放低離婚的事，借酒消愁醉倒街上，幸楊光路過送他回家。楊光約可人欣賞演唱會，可人悉心打扮赴會，但楊光臨時接Ada來電而失約，託孝武陪可人喫飯陪罪。楊光對Ada未忘情，不想與可人發展感情，藉機說出二人只存兄妹關係，可人大受打擊。可人得母霍玉清、妹可喜及可愛開解。可愛更說服可人大方面對楊光。國棟母小嫻告知他國寶失蹤。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高膽固醇是「三高」之中最為人忽視，但高膽固醇會引致心血管疾病，所以更加值得留意。《醫度講》這集，藝人鮑聖光前來細談患高膽固醇情況。此外，胡依諾醫生為大家解構高膽固醇問題，而中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟各位分享高膽固醇的食療與按摩穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#16粵
programme.desc: 若嵐帶領眾人捉姦，果然發現九妹與雙春一起；永禎向飛揚說出如果他能拯救雙春及九妹便答應離開佼佼鎮。眾人在祠堂公審雙春與九妹，在祠堂外偷聽的永禎，明白九妹想公開自己的太監身分讓雙春脫罪……飛揚與鎮長及所長提出欲把大事化小，鎮長決定把雙春與九妹逐出佼佼鎮……若嵐打算與永禎上契成為母子，飛揚在眾人前只得贊成。勝天得悉眾人將往廟宇，特意安排金鳳與婉君暢談。眾人喫茶點時，婉君說出當年與飛揚及勝天相遇之往事……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#84粵
programme.desc: 婷在家中大演話劇，目的是要朋準許她到臺灣進行粵劇交流，但朋不肯答應。婷為逹目的竟到藥房靜坐，剛巧遠房親戚的孫子Madison，趁暑假由美來港投靠慶。陰差陽錯下，婷與Madison兩人竟到了離島度宿。

programme.title: 尚食#24粵普
programme.desc: 皇帝駕崩，皇后祕而不宣，要等太子回京；異常的氣氛惹起眾人的懷疑。有人到太子的書齋偷拿點心，被子衿抓到；漢王趙王突然回京，還指定要看醫史，幸太子妃幫忙才化險為夷；太子回程遭暗殺，他最終能否逃脫…

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫樸正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽覈公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗喫、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是隻能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的祕密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-(完)
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰纔是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一羣神祕又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視臺EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神祕事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》樸荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝樸星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市佔率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會樸仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，祕書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.desc: It's time to wake up but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon, Tinky Winky feels better but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moving Day
programme.desc: After last season’s victory, Aja and Krel struggle to relocate Mothership back to their Arcadia Oaks neighborhood, but their task is complicated when Toby and Eli discover the Royals’ Akiridion secret.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Sins Of The Past
programme.desc: After Heather is lured to the Northern Markets as a trap, Hiccup flies to find her, but when he arrives too late, Windshear is captured by Krogan

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - In Plain Sight
programme.desc: Hiccup and his crew are in search for dragon eye gems only to discover a spy amongst them In the midst of it all Dagur has run into an old nemesis

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - No Bark, All Bite
programme.desc: Hiccup and Stoick set forth to find willow bark while Gobber holds a cookoff for the merchants until things go a riot and the riders have to protect Berk

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Turbo Drift
programme.desc: The snails and Tito travel to Tokyo to film a commercial and Turbo is challenged to a drift race against a beautiful and mysterious female cricket.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Ready, Set, Glow Breakneck's Back
programme.desc: In order to investigate one of Skidmark's conspiracy theories, Turbo and Skid join a dangerous underground zip line raceThe crew is surprised when Whiplash enters the town's annual Tomato Games. Turbo discovers that Whiplash is really trying to keep an eye on an untrustworthy snail who is Whiplash's former mentor.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Paperbirds Rock And Egg Roll
programme.desc: A gang of crooks mistakes Archibald for a criminal mastermind. Archibald unearths a rock with mysterious - and feather-raising - powers.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Upset Captain
programme.desc: Pirate Captain says he doesn't want to be the captain anymore. Noddy investigates how they can help him and he soon finds the reason for the Captain's distress: someone took his beard! Noddy sets out in search of the missing beard.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of Revs & Tractor
programme.desc: Revs and Tractor are doing Tom's deliveries together, but only Tractor comes back. Why isn't Revs with Tractor? Tractor is too upset to explain what happened, so Noddy investigates to find his friend.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Toyland Circus
programme.desc: It's the Toyland Circus and all the toys are rehearsing an act - all except Smartysaurus, who rushes away, apparently too shy to take part. Noddy has to find a way to help Smartysaurus find an act for the circus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Deltoid's Missing Strength
programme.desc: Action-hero Deltoid suddenly loses all his strength and finds himself totally helpless. Noddy quickly starts an investigation: How can he help Deltoid get his strength back?

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hen Pecks The Ground
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hen didn't peck the ground. She was a proud mother who spent all her time looking after and cleaning her chicks. Fancy pancy Peacock upsets Mama Hen and makes her feel plain. All the animals are furious with Snooty Peacock… but the damage has been done. Eagle - Mama Hen's best friend - decides to lend Hen her most prized possession - A needle! And Mama Hen sews herself the most beautiful coat of new feathers. Everyone is delighted and they dance and dance and dance.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bat Hangs Upside Down
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bat didn't hang upside down. He used to fly all over Tinga Tinga, saying ‘Boo!' to all the animals and giving them a fright. Nothing could be more fun for Bat. But one day Bat went too far… and the animals decided to give Bat a dose of his own medicine. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat's Camping Chaos
programme.desc: Lauren and Sara lead a camping trip to the Scottish Highlands, but disaster strikes when Ajay and PC Selby are stuck in Pencaster with the tent and cooking equipment. Pat must transport them to the Highlands in the SDS Plane and put up the tent before nightfall in order to accomplish his mission.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The King's Armour
programme.desc: It's Knights and Dragons Day at school and Pat has to travel to a Welsh castle to pick up some ancient artefacts and Sarah Gilbertson's Auntie Jackie! Pat is rather partial to a suit of armour - and when he's presented with a real one at the castle, he can't resist trying it on! But the suit gets stuck shut, leaving the excitable children wondering where their artefacts are!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Horse Powered Dinkie
programme.desc: Farmer Green tells the cars about olden days, when the only transport was horse and cart. Maxi and Drifter say they would never be seen travelling that slow… or would they?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - FB's Sleepover
programme.desc: FB is excited about his sleepover with the other cars in the workshop but when the night draws in he is unsure of his unfamiliar surroundings. Big Chris helps set him at his ease

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cici Spectacular
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has asked CiCi to perform one of her stunts in front of a big crowd. CiCi is very nervous and Roary does his best to help his friend prepare for the event.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cry Cold
programme.desc: Big Chris is feeling ill so Marsha sends him to bed until he is better. Big Chris enjoys the attention rather too much and fails to let everyone know when he is on the mend.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Silent Parrot
programme.desc: The Pirate Captain is very worried. Scurvy the parrot isn't saying a word. Without him navigating they won't be able to go treasure hunting anymore! Why is Scurvy so quiet? Is there something wrong? Or is he hiding something? It's up to Noddy to investigate!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Vanished Ninjas
programme.desc: The Ninjas are preparing for an acrobatics show. But after Pat-Pat decorates them with glitter they don't turn up for their rehearsal. Noddy investigates, looking for the Ninjas, but only finds sticky things have gone missing round Toyland - Pat-Pat's glue-stick, the Naughticorns' sticky tape, the Builders' sticky putty. Noddy works out that the glitter made the Ninjas non sticky, so they borrowed sticky things to try and make themselves sticky again. Case closed!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Suitcase
programme.desc: Pat-Pat is packing for a sleepover at the Palace when her suitcase goes missing. Noddy follows the clues and discovers that the Pockets took the suitcase in order to get Pat-Pat's sleepy pillow. They wanted to keep the pillow because it reminds them of Pat-Pat and they would miss her while she was at the sleepover. Noddy finds the Pockets and the suitcase in the dark, just in time for the sleepover. Queen Sparklewings invites everyone to the sleepover. Well done Noddy!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Two Parties
programme.desc: The Naughticorns are having a party and naturally they want everyone to come. Trouble is, so are the Pirates. But when no one turns up to either party, Noddy investigates: Why has no one come to either party?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Double Finked
programme.desc: Magnus's nephew, Axel, arrives on the island and tells the Rescue Riders that he wants to join their team. But is he just a trickster like his uncle?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Divewings
programme.desc: When sea-dwelling dragons called Divewings start attacking ships near the island, the Rescue Riders have to find out what's making them so upset.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Great Paper Chase Home Is Where Ken's Heart Is
programme.desc: When Rodney draws and writes his own comic book, TZG secretly helps him transport it to the comic book store where creator Ken KaBlam is on the hunt for new talent. When Ken KaBlam gets homesick for his own hometown of Crostonburg, TZG secretly recreates the things me misses in Harmony Harbor.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Fly-A-Long Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

After that, he was no longer the prettiest beast in Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Colourful Life - EP3
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP26
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: Recipes To Live By - EP3
programme.desc: During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Ding Yishan became a "hellish food critic" because of his "golden tongue". He was both an enemy and a friend of the famous chef Gai Zhaotian. At the same time, he fell in love with the cheerful Hu woman Shi Rou. They then competed in cooking skills to determine who was better in terms of "taste". Yishan accidentally discovered his background. It turned out that his biological father died unjustly, and Zhaotian and his son were also suspected.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP26
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP11
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP17
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP12
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

programme.desc: During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Ding Yishan became a "hellish food critic" because of his "golden tongue". He was both an enemy and a friend of the famous chef Gai Zhaotian. At the same time, he fell in love with the cheerful Hu woman Shi Rou. They then competed in cooking skills to determine who was better in terms of "taste". Yishan accidentally discovered his background. It turned out that his biological father died unjustly, and Zhaotian and his son were also suspected.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP26
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP11
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP17
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP12
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

programme.title: 阿叔第26集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 回到那年老臺中第4集

programme.title: 南投資深藝術家第4集
programme.desc: 許多資深藝術家來自南投，他們也致力於推廣及傳承，不僅僅是藝術技法，藝術精神的流傳更是一項在地重要的文化資產。藉由簡介、創作理念、心路歷程、藝術教育推廣，其對於南投藝文發展的參與及敘述等面向，邀請觀眾一同進入豐富的藝術饗宴。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第256集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大樑，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣臺語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句臺灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 大雲時堂第21集

programme.title: 名人書房第76集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第175集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人書房第13集
programme.desc: 閱讀就像是漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中！每位名人的讀書故事，皆是一段動人的奇幻旅程，透過《名人書房》紀錄影片帶領大眾看見閱讀改變生命的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第256集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第35集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1439集
programme.desc: 以 證嚴上人出門行腳各地的隨緣開示為內容，近距離同霑一代宗師的法髓甘露與清淨智慧。以真實記錄譜寫現代阿含經，使全球大眾如同親隨。

programme.title: 映照人生第500集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 行動現場第550集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 風月同天第11集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 月娘第10集
programme.desc: 薛月，一個哈瑪星魚市場大盤商家的千金小姐，平日喜歡去看歌仔戲及追星的浪漫女孩。講義氣又愛佈施，傳承自種公益田做善事的父親。 頗有佛緣的她，曾經夢見自己是觀世音菩薩旁的侍女，因而想出家修行，令薛家父母忙著替她相親找對象。然而阿月自有愛情的憧憬，不論出身好壞，只要彼此心靈契合，她相信就能廝守一生。 就這樣，阿月遇見了在左營軍樂隊服役的鄭添吉，兩人因樂曲而相知相戀，阿月眼中，他就像是戲裡貧窮卻不失志的小生，阿月相信只要相愛，就能突破困頓，迎向幸福。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第91集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人羣的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人羣的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 臥龍好歲月第5集
programme.desc: 臥龍街206號是一個小巧的環保站，許多樸素的人進出來往，做著一些重要的小事，看起來不像繁華的大安區，可是建商看上這裡的潛力，市政府（地主）也希望發展地方，當建商遇到市政府，那一天，都更公文送來了環保站⋯⋯

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第56集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第34集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚癡。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 快樂小蘑菇第16集
programme.desc: 這是一部以學前幼兒人文與品格教育為主的節目，從孩子的行為為動機，透國內外相關繪本為講述故事，藉由孩子發現問題來省思並靜思，最後再實現到生活中。內容分別都是學齡前孩子會出現的行為，如：搶玩具，分享，禮儀，害怕，不喜歡自己，生死，感恩，惜福...…等，適合全家，師生，教育工作者，一起欣賞…

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第83集
programme.desc: 關於「喫」，該怎麼喫得有智慧、喫出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1105集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 包青天第108集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 我們的島第1354集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年臺灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是臺灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 下課花路米第1377集

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第107集

programme.desc: 細膩刻畫人類與自然共存、破壞到重建復原的歷程。透過頂尖攝影技術，揭示水資源與野生動物環環相扣的生命線，展現德州在北美生態保護中不可或缺的重量。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第60集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在臺灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第949集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視臺的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第116集
programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: 去唱卡拉OK吧!第1集
programme.desc: 國中合唱團團長岡聰實，被黑道成員成田狂兒纏上，要求他教自己唱歌，原因是不想輸掉歌唱比賽被懲罰。特訓過程兩人意外建立起一段奇妙友誼。

programme.title: 銀河戰士特訓班第1集
programme.desc: 曾是散打銀牌的詹士豪，是臺灣特攝影集《銀河戰士》男主角的替身，但苦無機會且驕傲自大，在一次拍攝的不滿中，捲款逃亡，淪為罪犯來到漁港小鎮準備潛逃出境，卻誤打誤撞認識了大武，士豪半哄半騙答應傳授大武功夫，一起保護即將被拆遷的大象公園，但士豪卻在拆遷日當天搭上了偷渡漁船......

programme.title: 行走TIT第403集
programme.desc: 臺灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新臺灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 小島同樂繪第2集
programme.desc: 繪本不只是故事，而是一張地圖；地圖也不只是工具，而是一個個熟悉又奇幻華麗的臺灣地貌風景。繪本傳承的不僅是文化，更是深藏在文化底下的民族根性。

programme.title: 歐吉桑騎士-阿順阿忠的中年危機第4集
programme.desc: 星馬影帝李銘順、李銘忠兄弟檔首次合體，要騎著臺灣最常見的「摩托車」，成為名副其實的「騎士」，用最接地氣的角度，重新認識待超過十年的臺灣，探索寶島可愛的人文風景，也找尋自己中年危機的答案。

programme.title: 阮三個第11集
programme.desc: 以在地文化出發，由藝人組成團隊一同經營一間民宿，透過鏡頭記錄他們同居一屋簷下的趣事，以及接待客人、與當地居民搏感情的真實互動。

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第116集
programme.desc: 《公視晚間新聞》因為新聞內容淨化、幾乎看不到其他臺灣新聞臺的血腥、火爆的場面，且素材多元，針對民生消費、臺灣政經社會、人文環境等議題報導都極為深入

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第15集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地瞭解全球情勢。

programme.title: 一字千金第4集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是臺灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能製作公司製作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題並體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，並曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，並以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為範疇。至於答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 也好喫第8集
programme.desc: 與來賓一同造訪街邊小喫、家常料理餐廳，或拜訪各具特色的餐飲職人，從一碗麵、一盤菜出發，細細梳理食物背後的故事、時代脈絡與文化記憶；同時分享簡單易學、人人都能動手嘗試的料理方法，讓觀眾在觀看的同時，自然而然產生「想喫、也想做」的衝動。

programme.title: 髮圈第1集
programme.desc: 8歲的小魚和15歲的阿桂是一對同父異母的姊妹，生活在一個沒有大人的家裡。最後小魚看見阿桂的脆弱，才發現原來阿桂跟她一樣也只是個小孩。

programme.title: 湖面交界第1集
programme.desc: 三年前的意外後，兄妹兩人的關係變得疏離。如今即將離家上大學的妹妹小蓉，面對現實中無法溝通的宅男哥哥阿睿，小蓉選擇透過遊戲假扮身份接近他，用最笨拙的方式試圖找尋些什麼。

programme.title: 極樂世界之好好出門第10集
programme.desc: 貼身紀錄不同障礙者出門的過程，以輪椅的高度、視障者的視野、聽障者的感知，帶大家一窺障礙者出門的奇遇，透過影像紀實，打破障礙者的舒適圈，帶出障礙者每次面對環境的種種困境，與他們如何面對身體與社會環境的雙重挑戰。

programme.title: 緣起不滅第1集
programme.desc: 故事講述一對韓國母女珠熙和梓希在各自所處的年代陷入了三角戀情的經歷，珠熙最終面臨了愛人的生離死別，但是梓希反而因為母親珠熙無果的戀情，牽起屬於自己的情緣。
